summary: Publish HTML, Markdown, and multi-file sites as shareable URLs instantly via MCP.

toolsPreview.name: publish
toolsPreview.description: Publish HTML or Markdown content as a shareable URL. Pass `content` byte-for-byte from the source — do not retype, reformat, minify, summarize, or 'clean up' the input; even one stray character can break inline scripts on the published page. If the content is too large to copy verbatim through the model, use the REST endpoint `POST /v1/artifacts` (or `/v1/artifacts/upload` for ZIPs) instead. For Markdown, optionally include images as base64-encoded data.

toolsPreview.name: publish_site
toolsPreview.description: Publish a multi-file HTML site from a base64-encoded ZIP file. The ZIP must contain an index.html at its root. For sites larger than ~10MB — or whenever you have the file on disk — prefer the REST API /v1/artifacts/upload endpoint to avoid base64 overhead and to guarantee byte-faithful upload.

toolsPreview.name: get
toolsPreview.description: Get artifact metadata. Set include_content to true to also return the full HTML content.

toolsPreview.name: versions
toolsPreview.description: List version history of an artifact
